source.text: Lame's thick tube under an inside pressure of 5 MPa and none outside: sigma_theta = p a^2 / (b^2 - a^2) (1 + b^2 / r^2), here at the first cladding cell centre r = 4.1594 mm (a = 4.12 mm, b = 4.75 mm). The cladding is uniformly heated, which adds no stress in a free tube.
source.check: FEED's real-solver test (tests/mechanicsSolver.test.ts, a gas pressure) finds the inner hoop stress of the Lame value to 3 %, and its independent solution reproduces the Lame tube to 1e-9 (tests/mechanicsInternalPressure.test.ts).

coverage.domain: synthetic pin at 10 W/m in a 600 K coolant, both solids linear elastic (E 200 GPa, nu 0.3) stress-free at 300 K, constant conductivities; thermo-elastic, small strain, no creep, plasticity or swelling; axially fixed, a constant gas pressure of 5 MPa in the open gap, no coolant pressure
